name: Brother Perro
source:
"Why all of this is happening? That's all your fault, Toronto."

Brother Perro is a Linear Visual Novel with elements of mystery, thriller and supernatural.

Be awakened by your mother to go to school. Find out why everybody in your house are missing. Well, with the exception of your friend, Toronto. Explore the house, play your way out of this 'dream' and find the truth behind all of this mystery.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/831100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“为什么会发生这一切？这都是你的错，多伦多。”

《佩罗兄弟》是一部带有神秘、惊悚和超自然元素的线性视觉小说。

被妈妈叫醒去上学。找出为什么你家里的每个人都失踪了。好吧，除了你的朋友多伦多。探索这座房子，走出这个“梦”，找到所有这个谜团背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/831100/]Steam[/url]]
